promotions_proposed.requirement: Auto Pickup ON/OFF works, persists, and never interrupts attack/movement.

clause_evidence.never_interrupts_attack: tests/test_stage16b_authority_profile_loadout.py::test_31 - the toggle does not clear or restart the authoritative ATTACK_COOLDOWN
clause_evidence.never_interrupts_movement: tests/test_stage16b_authority_profile_loadout.py::test_30 - motion state (position, stamina, mode, heading, elapsed) is byte-identical across the toggle

promotions_proposed.requirement: Slope+surface+load affect authoritative stamina; yellow radial player-adjacent stamina circle depletes/refills and disappears completely at 100% when inactive.

clause_evidence.slope_surface_load: AuthorityTraversalRuntimeGate TRAVERSAL_STAGE16A_SLOPE / TRAVERSAL_STAGE16A_SURFACE / TRAVERSAL_LOAD_FROM_INVENTORY_CORE / ROAD_ADVANTAGE_AUTHORITATIVE / MUD_SPEED_PENALTY_AUTHORITATIVE / MODERATE_SLOPE_COST_ABOVE_FLAT_ROAD
clause_evidence.client_cannot_forge_refill: tests/test_stage16b_authority_traversal.py::test_12 - a client-supplied stamina field is rejected and the authoritative value is unchanged

promotions_proposed.requirement: Player quick loadout exposes exactly 2 weapon slots; inventory may contain more weapons; only one slot is active/equipped in MAIN_HAND at a time and inactive weapon modifiers do not stack.

clause_evidence.inactive_modifiers_do_not_stack: AuthorityProfileRuntimeGate ONLY_ONE_MAIN_HAND_MODIFIER_APPLIED / ACTIVATE_NO_INACTIVE_MODIFIER_STACK + tests/test_stage16b_authority_profile_loadout.py::test_21 and ::test_22 (the spare weapon never applies modifiers, before or after a slot swap)

backend_changes.why: G16B-21 states the inventory may hold more weapons than the two quick slots. With exactly two weapons in the world that distinction was assumed, never observed.
backend_changes.authority: Granted by the protected Stage05 item core. The adapter chooses nothing about the weapon beyond taking the last catalog definition.
backend_changes.idempotency: Each attempt uses its own event_ref and is verified against the live inventory, because the item core replays a stored grant and would otherwise report PASS while granting nothing.

gate_defects_fixed.defect: Command results were read by arrival index (_commands[0..2]). With Auto Pickup on, the ground-loot client injects its own REQUEST_PICKUP into the same stream and the checks read another command's result.
gate_defects_fixed.fix: _result_for_command() matches by command name; snapshots are read as the latest after the awaited result.

gate_defects_fixed.defect: MOVE_TO_POINT results were never collected: the gate filters command results to REPORT_TRAVERSAL_SAMPLE only.
gate_defects_fixed.fix: Dedicated _move_results collector for the refill steps.

not_promoted.G16B-04: PARTIAL_EVIDENCE. See AUTHORITY_G16B_04_BLOCKER_V0_8_1.json. The clean-world run reproduces the client/authority presentation divergence with a different magnitude (+0.41 m here, -0.089 m previously), confirming it is a client characteristic and not a tuning value.
